bakedboston_mip.label: BakedBoston Gurobi MIP
bakedboston_mip.description: Maximizes completed assignments first, then total route quality across simultaneous drivers.

random_feasible.label: Random feasible
random_feasible.description: Chooses randomly from routes that satisfy the same timing constraints.

shortest_route.label: Shortest route
shortest_route.description: Greedily chooses the smallest drive-plus-wait burden.

earliest_deadline.label: Earliest deadline
earliest_deadline.description: Greedily serves bakery pickup deadlines that occur soonest.

highest_priority.label: Highest pantry priority
highest_priority.description: Greedily favors pantries with the greatest current priority.

driver_fit.label: Driver destination fit
driver_fit.description: Greedily minimizes deviation from each driver's preferred destination.

selectionRule: After the joint Gurobi solve resolves simultaneous-driver conflicts, each driver's conflict-free recommendations are ranked and rank 1 is selected.
